verdict.rationale: Figma ships an official, well-documented MCP server (local and remote/hosted variants) with capabilities like writing to canvas, generating code, extracting design context, and generating designs from live UI, confirmed by docs and a live runtime probe showing the hosted MCP endpoint responding with proper MCP OAuth handshake. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of connecting third-party agents via the MCP server (only vendor docs and a technical probe, no community usage confirmation).
